components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default dashboard action with a lavender face and tactile lower edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid #a897ea;border-radius:10px;background:#cdc2f8;color:#14121e;font:700 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #a897ea;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease,background 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px);background:#d8cffc;border-color:#b5a5f0;box-shadow:0 3.5px 0 #b5a5f0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 #a897ea; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact supporting dashboard action with the same tactile response.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:10px;background:#1e1f2b;color:#fff;font:600 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease,background 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px);background:#252636;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:0 3.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A consequential dashboard action reserved for destructive changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid #b91c1c;border-radius:10px;background:#dc2626;color:#fff;font:700 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 #b91c1c;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease,background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { transform:translateY(-1px);background:#ef4444;box-shadow:0 2.5px 0 #dc2626; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 .5px 0 #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The canonical dark recessed field for product configuration.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:grid;gap:7px;color:#f7f5ef;font:700 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-input { min-height:42px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(19,20,31,.75);color:#fff;font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);transition:border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,background 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(19,20,31,.9); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:rgba(129,117,238,.6);outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(129,117,238,.6),0 0 0 2px rgba(129,117,238,.2); }

components.name: Depth Toggle
components.description: The flat-depth switch for settings and feature flags.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position:relative;width:44px;height:24px;padding:0;border:1px solid #b39ef8;border-radius:9999px;background:#c4b5fd;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.1);cursor:pointer;transition:background 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-toggle-knob { position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #9d87e8,0 2px 3px rgba(110,80,190,.35);transform:translateX(20px);transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1),width 140ms ease; } .ds-toggle:active .ds-toggle-knob { width:20px; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Pill
components.description: The active filter state for resource categories and discovery tags.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid #8175ee;border-radius:9999px;background:#8175ee;color:#fff;font:700 12px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 #5b4ccb,0 0 12px rgba(129,117,238,.35);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease,background 120ms ease; } .ds-filter-pill:hover { transform:translateY(-1px);background:#9084f8;box-shadow:0 2.5px 0 #5b4ccb,0 0 16px rgba(129,117,238,.45); } .ds-filter-pill:active { transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 .5px 0 #5b4ccb; } .ds-filter-pill:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-select-wrap { position:relative;width:260px;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-select-trigger { width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:4px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border:1px solid rgba(129,117,238,.6);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(19,20,31,.9);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(129,117,238,.2),inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);cursor:pointer; } .ds-select-trigger svg { width:16px;height:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45); } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8fd3ff;outline-offset:2px; } .ds-select-menu { margin-top:8px;padding:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:12px;background:#181726;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.6); } .ds-select-menu div { padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px; } .ds-select-menu div[aria-selected=true] { background:rgba(129,117,238,.25);color:#fff;font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview:
InterChat should feel like a precise, nocturnal operations map: communities are distinct places, connections are deliberate routes, and every control helps an operator understand or change the network. The product interface is compact and composed, with near-black layered surfaces, crisp edge definition, restrained signal color, and tactile state changes that make configuration work feel dependable.

The public experience expresses the same idea more editorially. Warm paper fields, contour lines, pins, route diagrams, annotations, and offset print-like shadows turn technical relationships into a welcoming community atlas. This is a surface-specific expression, not permission to make operational screens ornamental.

Despite legacy names in the implementation, heavy glassmorphism is not the current identity. Core product surfaces are opaque and layered. Blur is reserved for navigation chrome, dropdowns, tooltips, and modal overlays where separation from moving content is useful.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile bottom edges with restrained ambient depth
Violet action signals supported by sky, sage, and coral status cues
Topographic contours and route geometry as the signature motif
Warm, editorial Atlas compositions on public and reading surfaces
Compact controls, explicit hierarchy, and permission-aware navigation

rules.name: The Controlled Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet marks action, selection, or connection; it does not flood whole operational screens.

rules.name: The Two Environments Rule
rules.body: Dark is operational and paper is editorial. Do not introduce a light dashboard by reusing Atlas Paper.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Sky means route or focus, sage means safety or positive state, coral means attention, and red means destructive or invalid.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sora names places and decisions; Inter explains, labels, and operates them.

rules.name: The Shipped-Weight Rule
rules.body: New work uses the loaded Sora weights from 400 through 800. Do not request synthetic 850 or 900 weights unless font delivery is changed deliberately.

rules.name: The Shell Truth Rule
rules.body: Extend the active instance-rail and contextual-sidebar shell. Do not revive the unused 256px sidebar, 64px top bar, 12-column shell, or mobile bottom-navigation implementation.

rules.name: The Opaque-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Core application surfaces are opaque; a legacy “glass” identifier is not evidence that a component should look transparent.

rules.name: The One-Pixel Response Rule
rules.body: Product controls communicate hover and press through small vertical movement and changing edge depth, never dramatic floating animation.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner elements are never rounder than the container that holds them unless they are intentionally capsule-shaped controls or circular identities.

dos: Do model dense operational screens with opaque Midnight Ink and Surface Night layers.
Do reserve blur for navigation chrome and transient overlays where content separation matters.
Do reuse the violet, sky, sage, and coral semantics consistently across both environments.
Do preserve the active three-zone dashboard shell and its compact responsive drawer behavior.
Do use contour lines, route geometry, pins, and atlas annotations as the recognizable InterChat signature.
Do provide visible hover, active, focus, disabled, empty, loading, and invalid states for controls.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for reveal, route, and control animation.
donts: Don't revive translucent glass cards as the default product surface because a legacy component or identifier contains the word “glass.”
Don't treat the warm Atlas Paper environment as a supported light dashboard theme.
Don't use the disabled production-only staff interface or stock Ant Design styling as brand evidence.
Don't revive the unused legacy dashboard sidebar, top bar, grid shell, or bottom navigation.
Don't use violet decoratively when it does not communicate action, selection, focus, or connection.
Don't introduce unstyled native selects for prominent controls or inaccessible clickable containers for resource cards.
Don't request unavailable Sora weights or depend on color alone to communicate component state.
